# TypeVoice

> TypeVoice is a dictation app for Mac: hold a key, talk, and clean, punctuated text is typed into whatever app you're using. Speech recognition and cleanup run entirely on the Mac (Neural Engine, Apple Intelligence); no audio or text is sent anywhere, and it works offline. Open source (GPL v3). $79 once after a 7-day free trial, no subscription, no account.

Made by Priyam Ventures. macOS 26 or later on Apple silicon. English, all accents.

## Facts
- Price: $79 one-time (personal, 2 Macs); $299 one-time team key (5 people, 2 Macs each); 7-day free trial without a card; 14-day refund.
- Privacy: recognition on-device; the only network calls are a one-time model download, update checks, a country price lookup and license checks. No telemetry.
- Notable features: push-to-talk or hands-free; voice notes you can drag into chats; a Dictionary matched by sound; an optional note appended to every dictation for AI coding assistants ("dictated; spellings may be off"); question marks, lists, numbers and filler removal by rule.
- Source: https://github.com/warplabshq/typevoice
